question: What was India’s rank in the Global Peace Index 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**115th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **In the Global Peace Index 2025__, India was ranked __115th__ out of 163 countries, with a peace score of __2.229__, unchanged from 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s peace score remained stable at 2.229__, reflecting ongoing internal security challenges, border tensions, and urban safety concerns.**
 
• **India ranks __115th__, indicating challenges in maintaining national peace and stability compared to other nations.**
 
• **Factors influencing India’s rank include __internal security issues__, __border conflicts__, and varying effectiveness of law enforcement.**
 
• **India’s performance aligns with broader geopolitical and security dynamics, influencing its overall peace score.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Global Peace Index**__

 __
 
• Measured on 23 indicators__ like societal safety, ongoing conflict, and degree of militarisation.
 
• A __lower score__ indicates a higher level of peace, with Iceland ranking as the most peaceful country in the world with a score of __1.095__.
 
 
 
• __**Factors Affecting India’s Rank**__
 __
 
• Internal Security Challenges__: Including insurgencies and localised conflicts.
 
• __Border Tensions__: Persistent tensions with neighbouring countries impacting peace.
 
• __Urban Safety Concerns__: Crime rates and law enforcement issues in cities.
